body: Merge seat: a fresh review REQUESTED CHANGES on #2586 at a1260f94bc. The cache-sidecar detection can't fire in a real contained session: a host replace detaches the bind, so the sandbox path never shows nlink 0 (end-to-end repro: unshare -rm, a fresh AIDA_CONTAINED=1 aida doctor reports nothing). Also, only queue work exports AIDA_CONTAINED. The fix needs a spec/premise decision (detect in long-lived holders such as the MCP server?), so I haven't dispatched rework. Details are on the PR and the spec. #2586 is not a factory PR; tell me if you want the merge seat to drive a rework.
